Fixed Key: Her Fixed Key - Intel Acquisition can quickly cleanse enemy targets' buffs, while her Fixed Keys - Knower of Hearts and Fixed Key - Gentle Ministrations increase Springfield's healing abilities, easing healing pressure in high-damage conditions.\nShared Key: Her Shared Key increases her ability to recover stablity and ensures the teams' stability is in a healthy place, thus increasing her survivability. Increasing her out-of-turn damage improves Taryz' damage and thus her own damage output.
column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Intel Acquisition miliknya bisa cepat membersihkan buff target musuh, sementara Fixed Key - Knower of Hearts dan Fixed Key - Gentle Ministrations menaikkan kemampuan heal Springfield, sehingga beban heal di kondisi damage tinggi jadi lebih ringan.\nShared Key: Shared Key miliknya menaikkan kemampuannya memulihkan stability dan menjaga stability tim tetap sehat, sehingga daya tahannya naik. column1: Fixed Keys: The Fixed Key - Mature Aplomb accelerates Leva's personal economy and provides Superconductive Code at the start of the battle, which translates to additonal critical damage for all skills. The Fixed Key - Fox's Smile greatly increases Leva's damage against enemies with 0 stability. The Fixed Key - Play It By Ear efficiently cleanses her target's buffs and weakens their combat power.\nCommon Keys: Common Keys increase Leva's personal damage output. Electric debuffs allow Leva to fully benefit from the damage increase provided by Common Key - Elite Agent. When Leva faces boss units, the damage boosts from Common Key - Artistic Inspiration and Common Key - Mangle cover all forms of damage output that Leva possesses.
column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Mature Aplomb mempercepat perputaran ekonomi pribadi Leva dan memberi Superconductive Code di awal pertempuran, yang berarti critical damage tambahan untuk semua skill. Fixed Key - Fox's Smile menaikkan damage Leva terhadap musuh ber-stability 0 secara besar-besaran. Fixed Key - Play It By Ear membersihkan buff target dengan efisien dan melemahkan daya tempurnya.\nCommon Key: Common Key menaikkan output damage pribadi Leva. Debuff Electric membuat Leva bisa sepenuhnya menikmati kenaikan damage dari Common Key - Elite Agent. Saat Leva menghadapi unit boss, dongkrakan damage dari Common Key - Artistic Inspiration dan Common Key - Mangle mencakup semua bentuk output damage yang dimiliki Leva.

column1: Most of Robella's damage comes from Freeze Damage, allowing her to consistently benefit from Freeze Damage buffs. She also frequently performs out-of-turn attacks, enabling her to quickly stack buffs related to out-of-turn damage and fully capitalizing on her weapon's effects.
column2: Sebagian besar damage Robella berasal dari Freeze Damage, sehingga dia konsisten menikmati buff Freeze Damage. Dia juga sering melepas serangan di luar giliran, sehingga cepat menumpuk buff yang berkaitan dengan damage di luar giliran dan memanfaatkan efek senjatanya secara maksimal.

column1: Robella primarily deals damage through out-of-turn attacks, most of which are Freeze Damage, allowing her to consistently benefit from Freeze damage buffs.
column2: Robella terutama memberi damage lewat serangan di luar giliran, yang sebagian besar berupa Freeze Damage, sehingga dia konsisten menikmati buff damage Freeze.

column1: Fixed Keys: Fixed Key - Justice Has Arrived allows Robella to decrease enemies' defense and thus increase damage dealt by ally units. Combined with Fixed Key - Extra Attention, it allows her to reliably build stacks of Sense Weakness. Fixed Key - Third Gen Neural Cloud allows Robella to steadily and reliably increase her attack. \nCommon Keys: Common Key - Justice Is My Strength increases Robella's damage output when she has a shield, while Common Key - Strategic Negotiation's increase to out-of-turn damage matches up very well with Robella's main damage-dealing method. Since Robella primarily delivers her damage after her teammates have attacked, Common Key - Mangle provides a reliable increase to her DPS.
column2: Fixed Key: Fixed Key - Justice Has Arrived membuat Robella bisa menurunkan defense musuh sehingga damage unit sekutu naik. Dipadukan dengan Fixed Key - Extra Attention, dia bisa konsisten menumpuk Sense Weakness. Fixed Key - Third Gen Neural Cloud membuat Robella bisa menaikkan attack-nya secara stabil dan konsisten. \nCommon Key: Common Key - Justice Is My Strength menaikkan output damage Robella saat dia ber-shield, sementara kenaikan damage di luar giliran dari Common Key - Strategic Negotiation sangat cocok dengan cara utama Robella memberi damage. Karena Robella terutama melepas damage setelah rekan setimnya menyerang, Common Key - Mangle memberi kenaikan DPS yang konsisten.

column1: Lainie relies entirely on damage dealt by active attacks and can maintain permanent uptime on her defense-ignoring effects. Lainie's Simulacrum inherits the weapon's skill and can gain her damage-ignoring effects with no additional steps needed, which also allows her to trigger Lainie's various skill effects more easily.

Simulacrum milik Lainie mewarisi skill senjatanya dan bisa mendapat efek pengabai damage tanpa langkah tambahan, sehingga berbagai efek skill Lainie pun lebih gampang terpicu.

column1: Lainie's Simulacrum is a physical summon and deals a larger proportion of her damage. The UMP40's effects perfectly cover that.
column2: Simulacrum milik Lainie adalah summon fisik dan menyumbang porsi damage yang lebih besar. Efek UMP40 mencakup itu dengan sempurna.
